description.en: Eight clean, cool-toned themes with diffused wallpapers, accent colours and shareable theme packs.
description.zh: 8 套清透冷调主题，含弥散光壁纸、强调色与可分享的主题包。

description.en: A Your Name themed skin for the web GUI, with wallpapers and logo assets.
description.zh: 《你的名字》主题，配壁纸与标识素材。

description.en: A blue fish pet on screen that plays magic, snacks and chats, and shows your balance.
description.zh: 桌面上养一条蓝色小鱼，会玩魔术、吃零食、打盹，也能显示余额。

description.en: A registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity; several pets available.
description.zh: 由注册表驱动的悬浮宠物，会随模型活动做出反应，可换多只。

description.en: Put your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat interface.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的动态壁纸放到对话界面后面。

description.en: One panel to browse, preview and switch skins; skins are plain asset folders.
description.zh: 在一个面板里挑皮肤、预览、切换，皮肤本身就是素材目录。

description.en: Two whale maids, navy lace and a chibi sidebar as a full interface theme.
description.zh: 两位鲸鱼女仆、海军蓝蕾丝与小尺寸侧栏组成的整套界面主题。

description.en: Send memes from the composer, filter by mood, preview large, import or export libraries as ZIP.
description.zh: 输入框一键发图，按情绪筛选、悬浮看大图，图库可导入导出。

description.en: Switch between installed skins and tune each skin's own options.
description.zh: 在已装皮肤之间切换，并单独调整每套皮肤的参数。

description.en: Black-whale operator look with square corners and line-redrawn icons.
description.zh: 黑鲸操作员风格：方角、重绘线条图标，整体更硬朗。

description.en: Adapts the web interface to portrait and mobile screens.
description.zh: 让网页界面适配竖屏和手机。

description.en: Injects a short handoff note into a new session, reusing the previous summary when there is one.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条接续提示，没有交接文档就复用上次的压缩摘要。

description.en: Host-authoritative board for tasks and cron runs, executed as real sessions.
description.zh: 由 Host 掌管的看板，任务和定时运行都会真的起会话执行。

description.en: A corner widget showing balance, today's spend and peak/off-peak pricing, with custom click actions.
description.zh: 右下角挂件：余额、今日用量、峰谷价格，点击动作可自定义。

description.en: File tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, per conversation.
description.zh: 把文件树、编辑器、改动、任务和侧边对话收进一栏，每个会话独立。

description.en: One install that pulls in the whole dsh-web family of UI plugins.
description.zh: 一次装齐 dsh-web 系列的全部界面插件。

description.en: Adds one settings section that hosts the dsh-web family options.
description.zh: 在设置页加一个分组，集中放 dsh-web 系列插件的选项。

description.en: An interactive terminal interface for agents, sessions and tools.
description.zh: 在终端里操作 agent、会话和工具。

description.en: Renders interactive UI blocks inline in replies via a fenced dsh-ui block.
description.zh: 让回复里直接渲染可交互组件，用 dsh-ui 代码块描述。

description.en: Archive, restore, favourite or delete sessions, and diagnose damaged logs.
description.zh: 归档、恢复、收藏、删除会话，还能诊断损坏的日志。

description.en: Fast history recall, full-screen settings skins, frosted glass, a modular sidebar and native menus.
description.zh: 极速历史召回、全屏设置皮肤、毛玻璃、模块化侧栏与原生窗口菜单。

description.en: Charts, forms, calculators and mini apps rendered inline in replies.
description.zh: 在回复里直接渲染图表、表单、计算器和迷你应用。

description.en: Chinese-friendly substring search over session history, with match navigation.
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索，支持中文短词匹配和命中跳转。

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里浏览、搜索、一键装社区插件。

description.en: Gives text-only models image understanding through an independent vision provider.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：接一个独立视觉供应商。

description.en: Web search, X search and page fetch for models, with a pluggable search stack.
description.zh: 给模型接网页搜索、X 搜索和抓页，引擎可插拔。

description.en: Web search across 27 engines without API keys.
description.zh: 27 个搜索引擎，不需要任何 API key。

description.en: Inline previews and a floating editor for spreadsheets and documents.
description.zh: 表格与文档的行内预览和悬浮编辑。

description.en: SSH connections with password, key or agent auth, plus multi-hop chains.
description.zh: SSH 连接，支持密码、密钥、agent 与多级跳板。

description.en: Exposes browser automation tools to the model.
description.zh: 把浏览器自动化能力以工具形式交给模型。

description.en: Looks up evidence-rated failure lessons from other agents through a public MCP service.
description.zh: 通过公共 MCP 服务检索带证据评级的失败经验。

description.en: Compresses sessions so a 100K window is enough, with month-long continuity.
description.zh: 压缩会话上下文，10 万窗口就够用，还能跨月接续。

description.en: Composable, view-based context with layered memory and pluggable sources.
description.zh: 可组合的上下文视图，分层记忆，数据源可插拔。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DSH.
description.zh: OpenViking 的记忆与上下文组合包。

description.en: Branch selector and commit graph with real host-side git operations.
description.zh: 分支选择与提交图，操作真的落在工作区 Git 上。

description.en: Native file and command tools for Windows, Linux and macOS builds.
description.zh: Windows / Linux / macOS 上的原生文件与命令工具。

description.en: A CLI hook that blocks destructive commands and secret file access.
description.zh: 命令行钩子：拦住破坏性命令和密钥文件读取。

description.en: Browse skills by source (bundled, project, user, custom), enable or disable them.
description.zh: 按来源浏览技能（内置/项目/用户/自定义），可启用停用。

description.en: Load and safely manage local Agent Skills from one place.
description.zh: 集中加载并安全管理本机 Agent Skills。

description.en: 331 summonable domain experts you can call into a session.
description.zh: 331 个可召唤的领域专家智能体。

description.en: Scan a QR code to open the same interface on your phone via LAN or tunnel.
description.zh: 扫二维码在手机上打开同一界面，走局域网或隧道。

description.en: Host config store, remote commands, terminal, SFTP and port forwarding.
description.zh: 主机配置、远程命令、终端、SFTP 和端口转发。

description.en: Browse skins, pets and community plugins from the workshop and install them in the GUI.
description.zh: 在界面里浏览工坊的皮肤、宠物和插件并安装。

description.en: Syncs GitHub issues into the task board.
description.zh: 把 GitHub issue 同步到任务看板里。

description.en: Connects WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and Matrix to DSH.
description.zh: 把微信、飞书、钉钉、QQ、Telegram、Slack、Discord、Matrix 等接入 DSH。

description.en: Reads Bilibili subtitles each day, picks what is worth watching and writes a digest.
description.zh: 每天读一轮 B 站字幕，挑出值得看的写成日报并 @ 你。

description.en: Chat with DSH in QQ private and group chats.
description.zh: 在 QQ 私聊和群里直接和 DSH 对话。

description.en: Brings major messaging platforms into the local DSH instance.
description.zh: 把主流即时通讯平台接到本机 DSH 上。

description.en: One package and one settings page: scan to reach your desktop DSH from a phone, LAN or public.
description.zh: 一个包一个设置页，手机扫码就能访问电脑上的 DSH。

description.en: A dashboard and command that show how context is composed and where it grows.
description.zh: 面板与命令：看清上下文由什么构成、涨在哪儿。

description.en: Per-session and daily cost, history, and pricing for 170+ models with plan quotas.
description.zh: 本会话与当日花费、历史记录，内置 170+ 模型价格与订阅额度。

description.en: Per-provider balance and coding-plan quota, with a live usage view.
description.zh: 按供应商看余额与 Coding Plan 额度，实时刷新。

description.en: An agent preset plus its composer lever for the web GUI.
description.zh: 一套 agent 预设，配输入框侧的快捷开关。

description.en: Multi-agent collaboration: captain, members, tasks with dependencies and shared memory.
description.zh: 多智能体协作：队长、成员、带依赖的任务与共享记忆。

description.en: Image generation via Gemini, OpenAI, Seedream, DashScope or a local ComfyUI.
description.zh: 接 Gemini、OpenAI、Seedream、DashScope 或本地 ComfyUI 出图。

description.en: Task persistence with personas, verification loops and a status card.
description.zh: 任务持续推进：角色风味、验收循环与状态卡片。

description.en: Community agent-preset manager that installs and switches presets.
description.zh: 社区 agent 预设管理：安装、声明、切换。

description.en: A team of long-lived bots with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.
description.zh: 一组常驻机器人，彼此发消息、能拉群聊。

description.en: Brings locally signed-in WorkBuddy models into DSH, with per-model image input and account pools.
description.zh: 把本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型接进来，支持逐模型图片输入与账号池。

description.en: A skill-only bundle that draws architecture diagrams from a description.
description.zh: 按描述画架构图的技能包。

description.en: A PRTS-inspired console theme with matching terminal colours.
description.zh: 致敬 PRTS 的终端风格主题，连终端配色一起换。

description.en: Catppuccin palettes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin.
description.zh: Catppuccin 几套配色，外加可开关的毛玻璃皮肤。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop inspired layout and typography for the web GUI.
description.zh: 照着 Claude Code 桌面版做的排版与配色。

description.en: A two-act startup animation with transitions and optional voice lines.
description.zh: 两幕启动动画，带转场，可配多条语音。

description.en: A real xterm.js + PTY terminal in the sidebar, with SSH host bookmarks.
description.zh: 侧栏里的真终端（xterm.js + PTY），带 SSH 连接簿。

description.en: List, start, stop and inspect containers on local or SSH hosts; read-only by default.
description.zh: 本机或 SSH 主机上的容器管理，默认只读。

description.en: An IDE-style git panel: branches, history and diffs in the GUI.
description.zh: IDE 式 Git 面板：分支、历史、差异都在界面里。

description.en: Tasks claimed, advanced and closed by the agent, written straight into a ledger file.
description.zh: 任务由 agent 认领、推进、关闭，直接写进台账文件。

description.en: One header button stops running turns and jobs, writes a plan, then resumes.
description.zh: 顶部一个按钮停下所有回合，留一份计划，再接着跑。

description.en: A node-based studio for scripts, storyboards and footage.
description.zh: 节点式创作画布：剧本、分镜、生成、成片。

description.en: Checks installed third-party bundles against npm and updates them in place.
description.zh: 拿已装插件去 npm 比版本，可原地升级。

description.en: Turns a Bilibili video into text: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, ASR and OCR.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频读成文本：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、转写与抽帧 OCR。

description.en: Cuts a video into citable storyboard frames, one per shot.
description.zh: 把视频切成可引用的分镜图，一个镜头一张。

description.en: Lets DSH watch a live screen or camera feed and score every frame.
description.zh: 让 DSH 看实时屏幕或摄像头画面，逐帧打分。

description.en: Windows computer use through an MCP server plus PowerShell helpers.
description.zh: Windows 上的电脑操作，走 MCP 服务加 PowerShell。

description.en: A reading workbench for PDFs: transcribe, search and discuss in place.
description.zh: 论文工作台：PDF 转录、检索、原地对话伴读。

description.en: A daily curated RSS briefing with an overall summary and top items.
description.zh: 每天一份 RSS 简报：总览加重点条目。

description.en: Scheduled GitHub trending digests by day, week or month.
description.zh: 按日/周/月抓 GitHub Trending 生成日报。

description.en: Image generation plus a full video pipeline in the GUI.
description.zh: 生成图片，同时带一条完整的视频流水线。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory stored as YAML, with per-session presets.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，用 YAML 存，可按会话套预设。

description.en: Keeps verbatim chapter archives with a zero-token index for small contexts.
description.zh: 逐字存档分章节，配零 token 索引给小窗口用。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid, older ones fade into summaries.
description.zh: 近的对话保持清晰，远的自动沉淀成摘要。

description.en: Indexes docs and code symbols so the agent remembers a project.
description.zh: 索引文档与代码符号，让 agent 记住整个项目。

description.en: Local-first cross-session memory on SQLite, with dual scopes.
description.zh: 本地优先的跨会话记忆，SQLite 存储，双作用域。

description.en: Ollama Cloud as an LLM provider.
description.zh: 把 Ollama Cloud 接成模型供应商。

description.en: Uses ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, Kimi, GLM and other coding subscriptions.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Kimi、GLM 等订阅接进来用。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT/Codex subscription over OAuth and use its quota.
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅 OAuth 登录，走它的额度。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy models as a provider.
description.zh: 把腾讯 CodeBuddy 的模型接进来。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every step to the right one.
description.zh: 维护一个模型池，每一步都路由到合适的那个。

description.en: Brings Qoder (Tongyi Lingma) in, with PAT pools and daily check-in.
description.zh: 接入 Qoder（通义灵码），支持 PAT 账号池与每日签到。

description.en: Token budget, milestones, git snapshots and retrospectives for long goals.
description.zh: 长目标管理：token 预算、里程碑、Git 快照与复盘。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents runs several models and combines their answers.
description.zh: 多个模型各自作答，再合议出一个结果。

description.en: Background automation with isolated agent runs, scripts and HTTP jobs.
description.zh: 后台自动化：隔离的 agent 运行、脚本与 HTTP 任务。

description.en: Continuable Codex/Claude CLI subagents with waiting and child events.
description.zh: 可续聊的 Codex/Claude 子代理，支持等待与子事件。

description.en: Native roles, routing, profiles and permission controls.
description.zh: 原生角色、路由、档案与权限控制。

description.en: A QQ bot IM channel for DSH.
description.zh: 把 qq 机器人接成 DSH 的 IM 通道。

description.en: Discord adapter for DSH sessions.
description.zh: 把 Discord 接成 DSH 的对话入口。

description.en: Exposes the web GUI to a chosen CIDR range such as a Tailscale net.
description.zh: 把界面开放给指定网段（例如 Tailscale 内网）。

description.en: Scan to continue the same session from a phone over LAN or the internet.
description.zh: 扫码在手机上继续同一个会话，走局域网或公网。

description.en: Runs one project across your own Windows and macOS machines.
description.zh: 让同一个项目跨你的 Windows 和 macOS 机器跑。

description.en: Provider-aware plan capacity plus local token statistics.
description.zh: 按供应商看套餐余量，同时统计本地 token 用量。

description.en: Sidebar cost metrics plus a full billing dashboard.
description.zh: 侧栏费用指标，配一个完整账单面板。

description.en: Shows the active provider's balance or subscription quota in the sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧栏显示当前供应商的余额或订阅余量。

description.en: Install, update and remove local skills and reuse them across agents.
description.zh: 安装、更新、删除本地技能，多个 agent 共用。

description.en: Local and remote knowledge bases with scoped recall.
description.zh: 本地与远程知识库，按范围召回。

description.en: Git and SVN change preview with confirmed branch switching.
description.zh: Git 与 SVN 改动预览，切分支前会二次确认。

description.en: Preflight, release and test DSH plugins from the command line.
description.zh: 从命令行预检、发布、测试 DSH 插件。
